honestLimitation.depth6Vs4096Budget: In the full 8-operator no-repeat space, reaching depth 6 requires expanding every node of depth 0..5 (1+8+56+336+1680+6720 = 8801 expansions) before the first depth-6 node is dequeued, which exceeds the frozen 4096 budget. A depth-6 witness in the unpruned tree is therefore reported BOUNDED_INCOMPLETE by design, and a dedicated unit test locks this in (statesExpanded 4096, queueRemaining > 0, witness null). Real DOM trees prune via dedup (F001 depth 2: 21/65 collapsed) and INCOMPLETE/failure non-expansion, so depth 6 may still be reachable for a given fixture; the BFS never claims otherwise. No full 24-fixture depth-6 browser sweep was run in T007 (cost: up to ~29k browser evaluations per fixture); that sweep belongs to T012 performance/stress, not to this task's acceptance.
honestLimitation.witnessScope: Browser spot-checks cover depth 1 (F001/F002/F003) and depth 2 (F001) only. Depth 3-6 behaviour is covered by pure unit tests with a fake evaluator, not by browser runs.

unitCoverage.tieBreak: lexicographically smallest sequence among same-depth witnesses, at depth 1 and depth 2
